hints.title: Locate Starting Cell
hints.text: Scan the grid to find your initial position marked by the asterisk symbol.

hints.title: Breadth-First Exploration
hints.text: Queue the starting cell and explore adjacent cells level by level to find the shortest unweighted path.

hints.title: First Food Cell Reached
hints.text: The first time BFS encounters a food cell marked by a hash symbol, return the accumulated steps.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Depth-first search explores exponential paths and does not guarantee shortest distance without exhaustive search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Breadth-first search visits each grid cell at most once in O(m * n) time and O(m * n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses BFS on unweighted grid with visited state management.
